rewrites.summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): far east; conservative. Scored relative to the national score (0.15) for Turkey. What a trans visitor in this province stands under is the national framework; no province-specific law, ordinance or incident series is documented. A leaked draft omnibus justice package (October 2025) would criminalise conduct deemed 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' (up to three years in prison) and participation in same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies (up to four years; same-sex marriage is not legal, so such ceremonies are symbolic), and would restrict gender-affirming care - surgery age raised from 18 to 25 with mandatory permanent infertility - with medical professionals facing fines or up to seven years and transgender patients up to three years for care outside the new limits, forcing treatment into underground settings. The 2025 monitoring report documents hostility institutionalised at national level, with senior officials' rhetoric and instructions to public institutions and violent police attacks on peaceful gatherings.
rewrites.tangentialFactors: National policy turbulence: the October 2025 package is a leaked draft, not enacted law, and the rights-monitoring organisation Human Rights Watch called it one of the most alarming rollbacks of rights in decades.
